g.text: FactStamp - Activity Diagram (Claim Submission to Consensus Verdict)
extension + MIME + magic bytes, max 5 MB
Verifier reviews and edits extracted text
Jaccard J(A,B) = |A n B| / |A u B|
Render inline duplicate warning with the
similarity percentage and a link to the
existing claim; disable the Submit button
Enter source URL and written explanation
Validate URL protocol (http / https only) and
min 8 words, anti-spam and anti-copy checks
Append Verification to the embedded array;
A = agreement ratio, R = average verifier
Write the settled claim back to Firestore
Push claim_verified notification to the bell;
fact-check card on the claim detail page
